title: Correct pressure magnitude
description: Essential: The final answer for part (1) must be 30 N (or equivalent).

title: Energy conservation to find v_B
description: Important: Applies conservation of mechanical energy to find the block's speed at point B (3 m/s).

title: Newton's law at point B
description: Important: Correctly applies Newton's second law (centripetal force) at point B to find the normal force from the track.

title: Momentum conservation for part (2)
description: Important: For part (2), applies conservation of linear momentum to find the common speed of the block-cart system.

title: Work-energy for heat generated
description: Important: Correctly uses the work-energy theorem or energy loss to calculate the heat generated (3.75 J) in part (2).

title: Correct heat magnitude
description: Essential: The final answer for part (2) must be 3.75 J (or equivalent).

title: Work from force-displacement graph
description: Important: For part (3), correctly calculates the work done by friction from the given force-displacement relationship (area under curve).

title: Work-energy for final speed
description: Important: Applies the work-energy theorem using the friction work to find the block's speed when it leaves the cart.

title: Correct final speed magnitude
description: Essential: The final answer for part (3) must be sqrt(6)/2 m/s (or equivalent numerical value).

title: Sign or direction error
description: Pitfall: Misapplies sign for work done by friction (negative) in the work-energy theorem.

title: Unit omission or mismatch
description: Pitfall: Fails to include correct units (N, J, m/s) in final answers or uses inconsistent units in calculations.
